CLASS cl_neutral_additions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_cell,
        cell_id TYPE i,
        label_text TYPE c LENGTH 60,
        code_text TYPE c LENGTH 8,
      END OF ty_cell.
    TYPES tt_cell TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cell WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_search,
        cell_id TYPE i,
        score_value TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 3,
        label_text TYPE c LENGTH 60,
        mapped_text TYPE c LENGTH 60,
      END OF ty_search.
    TYPES tt_search TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_search WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_element,
        element_value TYPE i,
        position_value TYPE i,
      END OF ty_element.
    TYPES tt_element TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_element WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_identity,
        cell_id TYPE i,
        execution_user TYPE c LENGTH 60,
        execution_schema TYPE c LENGTH 60,
      END OF ty_identity.
    TYPES tt_identity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_identity WITH EMPTY KEY.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      search_cells
        IMPORTING VALUE(it_cells) TYPE tt_cell
                  VALUE(iv_query) TYPE string OPTIONAL
        EXPORTING VALUE(et_search) TYPE tt_search,
      difference_cells
        IMPORTING VALUE(it_left) TYPE tt_cell
                  VALUE(it_right) TYPE tt_cell
        EXPORTING VALUE(et_diff) TYPE tt_cell,
      expand_values
        EXPORTING VALUE(et_values) TYPE tt_element,
      identity_cells
        IMPORTING VALUE(it_cells) TYPE tt_cell
        EXPORTING VALUE(et_identity) TYPE tt_identity,
      optional_value
        IMPORTING VALUE(iv_seed) TYPE i OPTIONAL
        RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_neutral_additions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD search_cells BY DATABASE PROCEDURE FOR HDB
                      LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT OPTIONS READ-ONLY.
    et_search = SELECT cell_id,
      MATCH_SCORE(label_text, :iv_query) AS score_value,
      COALESCE(label_text, 'none') AS label_text,
      MAP_DEFAULT(code_text, 'fallback') AS mapped_text
      FROM :it_cells
      WHERE APPROX_MATCH(label_text, :iv_query) = 1
        OR label_text IS NULL
      WITH HINT (NEUTRAL_PLAN);
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD difference_cells BY DATABASE PROCEDURE FOR HDB
                           LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT OPTIONS READ-ONLY.
    et_diff = SELECT cell_id, label_text, code_text FROM :it_left
      EXCEPT
      SELECT cell_id, label_text, code_text FROM :it_right;
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD expand_values BY DATABASE PROCEDURE FOR HDB
                        LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT OPTIONS READ-ONLY.
    DECLARE lv_values INTEGER ARRAY = ARRAY(2, 2, NULL, 5);
    lt_values = UNNEST(:lv_values) WITH ORDINALITY
      AS (element_value, position_value);
    et_values = SELECT element_value, position_value FROM :lt_values
      ORDER BY position_value;
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD identity_cells BY DATABASE PROCEDURE FOR HDB
                         LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT OPTIONS READ-ONLY.
    et_identity = SELECT cell_id,
      CURRENT_USER AS execution_user,
      CURRENT_SCHEMA AS execution_schema
      FROM :it_cells;
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD optional_value BY DATABASE FUNCTION FOR HDB
                         LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT OPTIONS READ-ONLY.
    rv_value = COALESCE(:iv_seed, 7);
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
